turns.user: How much is the late fee if I pay my loan late?

response.reply: According to the document titled **Fees**, a late fee of $15.00 is charged when a payment is more than 10 days late. Only one late fee is charged per missed payment, and no late fee is charged if your account is in an active payment plan and payments are made on time.

documents.title: Fees
documents.text:
Fees - Late fees
A late fee of $15.00 is charged when a payment is more than 10 days late. Only one
late fee is charged per missed payment, and no late fee is charged on an account in
an active payment plan as long as plan payments are made on time.

documents.title: Fees
documents.text:
Fees - Returned payment fees
A fee of $10.00 is charged when a bank transfer or check is returned unpaid. No fee
is charged for a declined debit card payment.

documents.title: Fees
documents.text:
Fees - Fees we never charge
There is no fee to set up a payment plan, to pay early, to pay in full, or to use
the chat assistant.
